title: imify self update result
description: Written to stdout by `imify self update --json`.

updated.description: Whether the installer of a newer release ran. `false` when the running version is the latest release or newer.

previous_version.description: The version that ran the command.

version.description: The version installed after the command: the latest release when `updated` is `true`, otherwise `previous_version`.

install_prefix.description: The install prefix from the install receipt. The binary is in its `bin` directory.
